title: Hatsune Miku — Intro To Street Music〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The girls are improving so much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even just from the backing track they recorded, I can feel how strongly they want to make the solo show a success.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Shiho is especially on her game.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The way things are going, I'm sure they're on track for a great solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But even then, I know they won't stop there.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They're going to keep perfecting their performance until the last second.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to help them more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. I'll play it again from the start.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'll note down any comments or points for improvement and tell the girls later.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Oh... This part here.
Ichika said she felt like it lacked cohesion somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Could it be that it's slightly off-beat? Or is the sound muddy?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's listen one more time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Honami's drum beat is steady.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(She's drumming with power and confidence...
And it feels as if she's adding her own personality to it.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Although, she could probably hit the kick drum with more strength for this part...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know! I'll ask MEIKO and Luka what they think.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. It wouldn't hurt to hit the kick harder during that part.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, I think she could polish up the syncopated beat just before that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That way, she'll create a nice contrast when the kick comes in.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Polish up...the syncopated...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, what are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm making notes of issues I've noticed or parts that could be even better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That way, I'll remember them for the girls' next practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And that should do it! Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got their input. It makes sense that someone who plays an instrument regularly would spot things I wouldn't.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that sound... It's Rin and the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh yeah. They might also have some insight on today's practice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: While I'm here, I should go ask them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
I got so much good input from Rin and the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They were saying that Saki is rushing ahead in places, and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, what? Where's that sheet of notes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This sheet is MEIKO and Luka's advice... This one is KAITO's...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's weird. There should be one more...
Here you go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...! That's it! How did it get...here...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You dropped it, so we came to give it back.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO! And Rin and Len, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Silly Miku-P. It'd be such a waste to go losing your notes after working so hard on them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It really would. We were really shocked when we found them, you know.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “We”? I was the one that found them. Well, that isn't important...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, we need to talk to you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Talk to me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We were wondering whether we should all give advice to the girls together...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪ We want to help them pull off an amazing show just as much as you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. You don't need to put this all on yourself. We're with you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But, this is just something like a personal project of mine...
That's exactly what I'd call putting it all on yourself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO! Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The two of us talked after you left, and we thought of many other pointers we wanted to share with the girls.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, could you include us too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's no helping it. Well then, I guess we can all work on this together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Len and KAITO! Let's share what we talked about just now♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a pen and paper ready. Tell me everything.
